title: elegir (e → i), por mí, no quiero que se rompa, encontrarse, para que + mood, volver, también

cards.title: elegir: stressed e → i
cards.body: Related to 'elect' (elección). Some verbs turn a stressed e into i instead of splitting it: elijo, eliges, but elegimos.

examples.en: I choose / you choose / we choose

cards.title: por mí = on my behalf
cards.body: Por = on behalf of; para = intended for.

examples.en: I don't want you to choose for me.
examples.es: No quiero que elijas por mí.

cards.title: que se rompa vs que lo rompa
cards.body: Romper links to rupture, corrupt, disrupt. With se, you don't say who breaks it.

examples.en: I don't want it to break.
I don't want him to break it.

cards.title: para que + mood tense = so that
cards.body: 'Para comer' would mean so that WE eat; para que coman means so that THEY eat. Para is sometimes shortened to pa in speech.

examples.en: We've cooked so they can eat.

cards.title: volver = to come / go back
cards.body: As in 'revolve'; Spanish revolver means to stir. The o splits: vuelvo.

examples.en: I've done it so that you come back.
examples.es: Lo he hecho para que vuelvas.

examples.en: They've done it so that we come back.
examples.es: Lo han hecho para que volvamos.

cards.title: también = as well / too
cards.body: Tan (as) + bien (well): a direct match for English 'as well'.

examples.en: We've done everything so that you come back too.
examples.es: Hemos hecho todo para que tú también vuelvas.
